It was a very engaging onference hosted by the Oxford physics department. Here are all the [talks](https://indico.global/event/15713/timetable/#all.detailed). 

A lot of the discussion focused on the relationship between instabilities and space charge, which is not yet fully understood. For example Adrian Oeftiger gave a nice summary [here](https://indico.global/event/15713/contributions/165937/attachments/77085/149758/Oeftiger.pdf). 

The highlight was definitely the talk by [Ingo Hofmann](https://indico.global/event/15713/contributions/165940/attachments/76792/149819/Keynote-Oxford-final-2.pdf), who helped start the field of space charge physics.

I gave two talks, one about our work on [bunch compression](https://indico.global/event/15713/contributions/162546/) another about our work on [phase space painting](https://indico.global/event/15713/contributions/162570/). I got some useful feedback and several new ideas about where to go with this work.
